metadata.genre: educational podcast short — numbered top-3 explainer
metadata.rationale: Spine: cold-open hook (the sharpest one-liner in the file, src 214s) -> frame the question -> POINT 1 (src 24-37s) -> POINT 2 (src 96-142s) -> POINT 3 played dry (src 300-356s) -> held landing. Each point gets 1.5-3s of setup so it reads with zero prior context, and every cut is a jump cut on a breath/clause boundary so the speaker's wording is never altered or truncated mid-sentence — filler runs, long pauses and tangents are simply removed (e.g. src 8-18s, 43-96s, 143-300s are dropped whole). Rhythm: phase 1 avg 2.5s/shot, phase 2 avg 1.9s, phase 3 avg 1.4s, then a 4.0s landing hold longer than anything before it. Per the explicit request there are ZERO rendered transitions — hard cuts only — so plan.transitions is intentionally empty. Per the explicit request the 21 Savage bed runs low (0.20) from 0.0-30.0 and is dropped entirely for the final point (30.0-45.0), which is why the last third carries no music and leans on vignette/contrast/grain accents instead. Open captions run wall-to-wall in the speaker's phrasing, chunked to 4-10 words with reading time >= words/3, plus a title card at 2.05 (after the two hook shots) and 01/02/03 callouts on each chapter change. All accents are grade/tonal only — no glitch, aberration or blur — because this is a talking head.
